source.name: A Bola, 'Benfica revela novo equipamento principal, inspirado na formação'
source.quote: A Fly Emirates continua a ser o principal patrocinador, e a Betano o patrocinador secundário.
source.note: Kit-launch coverage of the 2026/27 home shirt. SAPO (26 Abril 2026, leaked photos) adds: 'Os logótipos dos patrocinadores, incluindo o da Emirates no peito, seguem a mesma linha, surgindo também a branco.' Sportcal (2024-08-14) documented the deal running to 2029.

source.name: Kaizen Gaming, 'Betano and SL Benfica renew partnership for 3 more years'
source.quote: was the first brand to occupy the sleeve of the official SL Benfica jersey and will remain as the 'Official Betting Sponsor' until the 2026/27 season.
source.note: A Bola's 2026-06-08 kit-launch report confirms Betano remains 'o patrocinador secundário' on the 2026/27 shirt; Sportcal (2024-08-14) reported the sleeve deal renewed through 2026-27.

source.name: SL Benfica, 'Benfica e adidas apresentam as camisolas oficiais 2026/27' (official site: main football-sponsors strip lists Emirates, Sagres, adidas, Betano)
source.quote: Sport Lisboa e Benfica and adidas officially unveil the home jersey for the 2026/27 season
source.note: The page's 'Patrocinadores principais do Futebol' strip carries logos alt-texted 'Patrocinador Sagres' (with Emirates, adidas, Betano). Official product photos (fportugal CDN, opened 2026-09-28) show SAGRES across the upper back. Press: SCC's 2023-08-25 release and Marketeer (2023-08-25) place Sagres on the back of the shirt; ECO (2026-03-09) refers to Sagres on the camisola. Wikipedia's 2026-27 Primeira Liga table also lists Sagres back, noting a Benfica Foundation swap in UEFA matches (unverified by named press).

source.name: Footy Headlines, 'Benfica 26-27 Home Kit Released'
source.quote: All sponsor logos, including Emirates on the chest, are applied in clean, solid white to match the accents.
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers.

summary: Emirates on the front (deal to 2029), Sagres on the back, Betano on the sleeve (to 2026/27), kit made by adidas: confirmed by the club's 8 June 2026 kit launch and its main-sponsors strip.
